text: The login button is completely broken. Our entire team cannot access the dashboard and we have a client presentation in one hour.
Would it be possible to add a dark mode to the dashboard? It would make long working sessions much more comfortable.
How do I export my data to CSV? I cannot find the option anywhere in the settings.
The export works but it sometimes skips the last row when the dataset is over 1000 entries. Not a blocker but should be fixed.
We noticed our API keys were exposed in the server logs. This is a critical security issue that needs immediate attention.
Can you add the ability to assign tickets to multiple team members at once instead of just one?
What are the rate limits for the API? I want to know how many requests per minute I can make.
I wanted to say thank you for the quick support last week. The team was very helpful.
